integrity: All 65536 Boolean feedback maps covered by a proved bijection; two independent enumerations and two independent definitions of the invariant cross-check the entire finite table. The source code is embedded and executable; historical priority may be limited by unindexed treatments.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite exhaustive theorem for binary order-five de Bruijn circles and one complete circular traversal only; no all-order generalization or claim of independent human certification.
title: A six-factor criterion for circular subsequence universality in binary de Bruijn cycles of order five
